Two thousand people showed up to see what flies. ✈️

Eastern Iowa Airport welcomed more than 2,000 visitors to its second annual Youth in Aviation Day in Cedar Rapids on October 17.

Families explored aircraft displays, tried aviation activities and met pilots and mechanics. Kirkwood Community College opened its aviation-maintenance hangar, while Coe College’s flight school welcomed visitors too.

That mix matters. Young people got to see that aviation is bigger than one cockpit: it takes pilots, maintainers, instructors and many other skilled people to keep an airport community moving.

A crowd of 2,000-plus is a pretty good reminder that curiosity about flight is alive and well—especially when local aviation opens the gate and invites everyone in.

Here’s to the next generation finding its place in the sky. 💙
